ask_mic_tap.cy: 🎤 Tapiwch Siarad a siaradwch — neu teipiwch isod
ask_mic_tap.en: 🎤 Tap Speak, then talk — or type below

ask_err_perm.cy: Mae caniatâd y meicroffon i ffwrdd — tapiwch 🔒 yn y bar cyfeiriad → caniatáu meicroffon
ask_err_perm.en: Mic permission is off — tap 🔒 in the address bar → allow microphone

ask_err_mic.cy: Methu defnyddio’r meicroffon — teipiwch eich cwestiwn
ask_err_mic.en: Can't use the microphone — please type instead

ask_err_nospeech.cy: Ni chlywyd llais — tapiwch Siarad eto
ask_err_nospeech.en: No voice heard — tap Speak again

ask_err_other.cy: Methodd mewnbwn llais ({code}) — teipiwch eich cwestiwn
ask_err_other.en: Voice input failed ({code}) — please type instead

cf_privacy.cy: Bydd eich enw ac amser y cadarnhad yn cael eu hanfon i’r gweithle fel cofnod hyfforddiant.
cf_privacy.en: Your name and confirmation time will be sent to the workplace as a training record.
